keyframe_review.note: New keyframe (Cliopatria lacks Fazughli). The infobox is a "Tentative estimation of the extent of the Kingdom of Fazughli" with no figure; Triulzi's description covers "the eastern, western, and southern territories, including the Gumuz, Burun, and Bertha countries". Blue Nile (Sudan) and Benshangul-Gumaz (Ethiopia) are my reading.

ledger.note: 1685: Sennar subdues Fazughli. "In 1685 'the Hameg princelings of Fazughli' were subdued by Sennar"; "the kingdom lasted until its incorporation into the Funj sultanate in 1685"; "the Funj retained the current ruler of Fazughli instead of replacing him with a new provincial governor". The funj-sultanate dossier has a gain in 1665 from the Funj page.

sources.title: Kingdom of Fazughli
sources.note: Established c. 1500 by refugees from Alodia (tradition), buffer between Sennar and Ethiopia, incorporated into the Funj sultanate in 1685, claimed conquest by Susenyos in 1615. No area or capital.

notes: New dossier: Cliopatria lacks Fazughli. One page opened (Kingdom of Fazughli; budget 1-2). Disagreement: the funj-sultanate dossier (af-01-b) has the Funj gaining Fazughli in 1665; this page gives 1685 and does not mention 1665; the page also reports Susenyos conquering Fazughli in 1615 as a claim. The page gives no capital, no rulers and no area; the capital coordinate is a stand-in. Gazetteer names needed: Fazughli (Fazogli, Blue Nile near the Ethiopian border, about 11.2 N 34.8 E).
